title: Zero-Sum Nash Equilibria As Saddle Points
body_html:
Zero-Sum Nash Equilibria As Saddle Points

In a zero-sum game, a pair of mixed strategies is a Nash equilibrium exactly when it is a saddle point of the matrix payoff.

References

  • [MFoGT, Proposition 2.4.1(d), proof paragraph] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Saddle points express the identity between optimal strategies and Nash equilibria.
